findings.title: Discover upsampling is enabled for mixed event-type queries
findings.body: The discover eligibility check only tests whether the raw query string contains `event.type:error`. A valid query such as `event.type:error OR event.type:transaction` therefore gets rewritten to `upsampled_count()`, even though it includes transaction events. Transactions do not have `sample_weight` (as noted by `_should_apply_sample_weight_transform` itself), so their rows will be omitted from or corrupt the summed count. Only enable this transformation after parsing/validating that the executed query excludes all non-error event types.

findings.title: Upsampling eligibility is evaluated against the outer dataset instead of the dataset being queried
findings.body: `_get_event_stats` receives `scoped_dataset`, including the `discover` dataset used by dashboard split queries, but passes the enclosing `dataset` variable to `is_errors_query_for_error_upsampled_projects`. Consequently, when a metrics-enhanced dashboard query is split into an error-only Discover query, the helper sees the original metrics dataset and refuses to upsample. The converse mismatch is also possible whenever this helper is called with a different scoped dataset. Pass `scoped_dataset` (and preferably the actual `query`) to the eligibility logic.

findings.title: Aliased count aggregations are not upsampled
findings.body: The transformation matches only a column whose entire text is exactly `count()`. Stats queries can use an aliased aggregation such as `count() as errors` (and query builders may produce aliases), which remains a raw count even for fully allowlisted error projects. This yields inconsistent and undercounted results depending only on the requested output alias. Parse the aggregation/alias or preserve the supplied alias while replacing the count function.

findings.title: An unconfigured git submodule was added accidentally
findings.body: This change adds a gitlink named `sentry-repo` pointing at the base commit, but no corresponding `.gitmodules` entry or repository URL is included. Fresh checkouts cannot initialize it and it contributes no usable source or configuration to the project. Remove this stray submodule entry unless the submodule configuration is intentionally added as part of the change.
